 Korea Open: An Chases Record-Equalling 11th Title
 Monday, November 2, 2026
 TEXT BY BWF STAFF | BADMINTONPHOTO 
 SHARE 
 The YEOSU VICTOR Korea Open 2026 gets under way this week at Jinnam Stadium in Yeosu, with a star-studded field led by world No.1 An Se Young . The French Open champion has already collected 10 titles this season and is one title away from matching her remarkable tally of 11 crowns from 2025. The Olympic champion begins her home campaign against Kaloyana Nalbantova. It will be their fourth meeting, with An holding a commanding 3-0 head-to-head advantage.
 Defending champions and top seeds Kim Won Ho/Seo Seung Jae open against Jiří Kral /Ondřej Kral in what will be the pairs’ first career meeting.
 In men’s singles, the withdrawal of eighth seed Li Shi Feng has triggered a reshuffle, with Lee Cheuk Yiu now facing world No.65 Prahdiska Bagas Shujiwo in the opening round. HYLO Open champion Lakshya Sen has also pulled out, prompting further movement in the draw and leaving Yudai Okimoto with a revised first-round assignment. The Japanese shuttler will face Dong Tian Yao.
 Olympic bronze medallist Anthony Sinisuka Ginting continues his climb back up the rankings against home favourite Jeon Hyeok Jin, while Yoo Tae Bin takes on Prannoy H.S.
 The women’s doubles draw has also been reshaped following the withdrawal of top seeds Yuki Fukushima/Mayo Matsumoto. Gabriela Stoeva/Stefani Stoeva occupy the top billing spot, while fifth seeds Sayaka Hirota/Ayako Sakuramoto also withdrew promoting new opponents for Lui Yu/Wang Ting Ge.
 Withdrawals 
 Men’s singles: Li Shi Feng, Lakshya Sen
 Women’s singles: Malvika Bansod
 Women’s doubles: Yuki Fukushima/Mayo Matsumoto
 Men’s doubles: Aaron Chia/Soh Wooi Yik, Tokumi Nomura/Yuchi Shimogami
 Mixed doubles: Wong Tien Ci/Lim Chiew Sien, Ki Dong Ju/Jeong Na Ean, Y.Shimogami/Sayaka Hobora
 Promotions 
 Men’s singles: Minoru Koga, Jeon Hyeok Jin
 Women’s singles: Kim Min Sun
 Men’s doubles: Takuto Goto/Tsubasa Yoshida, Choong Hon Jian/Wong Vin Sean
 Click here to view the updated draw.
 YEOSU VICTOR Korea Open 2026 begins tomorrow, with the first qualifying match scheduled for 9am Kuala Lumpur time.
